description.en: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line.
description.zh: 健壮有力，并且会直接冲向你的防御线。

chat.en: All-Star Zombie is a third-round draft pick and shows a lot of promise, but come on, his salary demands are beyond ridiculous. Ten million brains per year? For FIFTY YEARS?
chat.zh: 全明星僵尸通过了第三轮选秀，并且展现出了非凡的潜力。但是天啊，他提出的薪资简直是太夸张了。每年一千万脑子？而且持续整整 50 年？

text.en: charges like a flighty zombie upon entering the lawn and destroys the first plant he meets
text.zh: 蓄力飞速冲进草坪，并摧毁遇到的第一株植物

text.en: slows down and becomes a stiff zombie after tackling a plant
text.zh: 解决掉一株植物后减速，变得迟缓
